description: Check the status of a previously submitted booking or order by its code (the bookingCode returned when it was placed, e.g. WA-K4M2, for a table, stay, service or delivery request; a pre-order's code also works). Needs the same restaurantId used to place it and the phone number it was made with (ask the person; no sign-in needed). status 'pending' means the venue hasn't responded yet.

phone.description: The phone number the booking or order was made with. Ask the person for it; it is checked together with the code. No sign-in is needed.

name: check_booking_status
title: Check booking or order status
